headline: Virgin Media O2 Faces Job Cuts and Customer Losses Amid £22bn Debt Pile
summary: Virgin Media O2 has shed hundreds of thousands of broadband and mobile customers over two years, implementing job cuts while grappling with a £22bn debt pile.
why: High debt burdens and customer churn constrain capital expenditure and profitability for major telecommunications operators in competitive markets.

impacts.name: Virgin Media O2
impacts.why: Ongoing customer losses and massive debt directly impair the company's financial health.
